subject: Nimbus vendor activation & PO specs: kickoff and checklist
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <procurement@nimbus.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Nimbus vendor activation & PO specs: kickoff and checklist

Hi Elena / Nimbus procurement team,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the vendor activation for Nimbus. To keep things moving on our end, can you confirm the following and return the vendor intake materials attached? I want to capture the PO requirements up front so Procurement can issue a PO without back-and-forth delays.

Quick checklist we need from you:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached) + company remit address
- W-9 (or local tax form) and TIN/EIN
- Banking details for ACH (account + routing or SWIFT if outside US)
- Certificate of insurance if available (commercial general liability)
- Primary fiscal contact name, email, and purchase order reference format you prefer (if any)

Notes on PO line-items:
- We typically prefer a short, explicit line-item structure: service description / unit metric / unit price / quantity / total. For example: "Model Inference Credits — monthly usage (tokens) — $X per 1M tokens — qty 1 — $Y". If Nimbus needs vendor-side split (e.g., seat vs usage), flag that and include your suggested mapping.

Tentative timeline from our side: once we have completed vendor materials and tax docs, internal vendor setup usually takes 3–5 business days; PO issuance target is 48 hours after vendor code is active for standard SOWs. If there are contract signings or custom terms, add 3–7 business days depending on legal review.

I've attached our example PO template to show the format Procurement expects. If Nimbus has its own PO reference format, include an example so we can map fields back to our ERP.

Please send completed forms to this thread. Priyom and Laura are on copy to expedite the internal intake.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: example_po_template.xlsx (xlsx)

Hi Soojin —

Thanks — appreciate the clear checklist. Attaching our completed vendor onboarding PDF and the company W-9. A few quick items from our side:

- Timeline: we can return the completed forms by EOD 16-Feb. Our procurement team will then request vendor code creation; historically that completes in 3–7 business days depending on the buyer. Once Nimbus has a vendor code on your side we can accept POs.
- Line-items: Nimbus prefers a single service line for cloud consumption and a secondary line for professional services if applicable. Suggested format we use: "Nimbus Cloud Consumption — tokens/month — quantity as forecasted — unit price". If Redwood needs separate GL mapping for subscription vs usage, tell us the fields you need on the PO.
- Banking: We will provide ACH details in the vendor form.
- Contracting: We usually sign SOWs via DocuSign. If Redwood prefers a master services agreement before PO, let us know.

I'll attach the completed vendor form (nimbus_completed_vendor_form.pdf) and the W-9 in my next email thread message; sending now so you can confirm receipt.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Procurement Manager, Nimbus Systems
elena.ruiz@nimbus.io

Subject: RE: Nimbus vendor activation & PO specs: kickoff and checklist

Thanks, Soojin and Elena — looping in Procurement intake items and our standard PO/line-item rules so Nimbus has a clear target for submission.

Internal PO requirement confirmations (please provide back with the vendor form):
- Legal name exactly as you want it on the vendor record
- Remit/billing address for invoice processing
- W-9 / certificate of tax residence (TIN/EIN) — required before ACH setup
- ACH or wire details (we redact for security; procurement will request securely)
- Certificate of insurance (COI) for contracts > $50k preferred
- Fiscal contact + billing email for PO routing

Line-item structure guidance:
- Title: concise service label (max 60 chars)
- Description: one-line purpose + measurement unit (e.g., "Model inference — tokens consumed per month")
- Unit metric: define the billing unit (tokens, seats, monthly commitment)
- Unit price: USD amount per unit
- Quantity: if forecasting, put forecast qty with a note; otherwise QTY 1 with total expected value
- GL/Cost center: include your preferred GL mapping if you require coding on the PO

PO issuance timeline (our target windows):
- Vendor creation in ERP: 3–5 business days after receiving completed forms and tax docs
- Standard PO issuance after vendor code active: 48 hours for standard SOWs (no negotiated amendments)
- If SOW requires Legal review / negotiated terms: add 3–7 business days

If Nimbus wants POs tied to a contract number, include that number in the vendor form field "Preferred PO reference". For faster processing, mark any line items that are pre-approved (e.g., monthly committed credits) so we can auto-route.

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist_internal.pdf (PDF)

Laura Bennett
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
